readme: The 90-recipe wave for the SMP 100-recipe project (pilot 10 already live). Mix locked to Brad 2026-07-06: ~60% chicken/pork slow cooker (54) + ~40% beef/turkey (36). Each entry = selection metadata + source credit; gram amounts, macros, and cost are computed downstream to hit the gates (ratio <=15 ideally <=10, 500-700 cal/serving, <=$3/serving, 14 servings). base = starch/base to plate it as a complete dinner.
